description: Test suite for authentication hashing utilities, including v1 and v2 password hashing, verification, migration, and tenant salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieve the pepper value for password hashing.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hash password using legacy (v1) method with SECRET_SALT.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hash password using v2 method, incorporating tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verify a candidate password against stored hash and version.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensure tenant object has a generated orgSalt, generating and saving if needed.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper function that defaults to v2 hashing algorithm, respecting tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verify password with migration for legacy v1 hashes, upgrading to v2 if needed.
